programs.title: Ben Fogle: Return to the Wild 2
programs.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle revisits the participants of the "Life in the Wasteland" program.These people have in common the fact that years ago they decided to abandon their previous existence in favor of living in the bosom of nature, often in a remote area and in extremely harsh conditions.Ben will check, among others:what happened to a former war correspondent who became a grizzly bear expert.He will also revisit a former financier who is now living the life of Tarzan in a swampy area in Georgia.The presenter will find out whether these people are satisfied with their choices.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The program shows the everyday life of people in Canada and their struggles with the forces of nature.

programs.title: Jimmy Doherty's New Zealand Escape
programs.desc: Jimmy takes a trip to the tropical north to visit New Zealand.His culinary discoveries will not be the only attraction of the program.There will also be a visit to the winery and a show of seasonal specialties.

programs.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life
programs.desc: Everyday objects are prosaic companions of our everyday life and we rarely think about how they were created.However, they often hide fascinating stories.
